line.name: Camacho Limited Edition 2025
line.description: CORRECTION TO AN INITIAL ASSUMPTION: Mac filenames '25-Le'/'Cam-Le-25' were assumed to mean a 25th-anniversary release - research found '25' instead refers to the year 2025, not a milestone anniversary. No verified 25th-anniversary Camacho release exists. This is Davidoff/Camacho's annual limited-edition release, the successor to Camacho's long-running 'Liberty Series' (2002-2024) - billed as 'a Camacho limited edition without a fancy name,' focused on tobacco blending over a thematic concept.
line.factory: Diadema Cigars de Honduras, S.A., Honduras
line.status: limited edition (2025 run, ~2,300 metallic canisters of 20)
